**Test image analysis:**
- Large, dark brown-black necrotic lesion near the leaf margin/tip
- Yellow-green transition halo around the dark necrotic area
- Irregular, somewhat angular shape
- Small yellowish spots scattered on the remaining green tissue
- Overall green leaf otherwise healthy-looking

**Reasoning:**
The large coalescing dark necrotic lesion at the leaf margin with a yellow-green halo is consistent with an advanced Bacterial Blight infection, where early small water-soaked spots have merged into a larger marginal lesion. The scattered small yellow spots visible on the green portions of the leaf also match the Bacterial Blight reference pattern. The angular, dark (nearly black-brown) coloration of the necrosis is characteristic. Other candidates like Phytophthora typically show more pronounced wilting/stem symptoms, and Septoria shows smaller discrete spots rather than a large coalescing marginal lesion.
